effects.l1: Sure-footed: ignore difficult-terrain penalties for Water minutes.
effects.l2: Rock steady: stand, fight and hold any position on a narrow (4 in.) solid surface.
effects.l3: Tip toe: same on ropes or cloth 1–2 in. wide.
effects.l4: Perfect balance: balance on a single point (spear tip, bamboo tip) and act normally.

system.description: Perfect balance on difficult or narrow surfaces. Not movement by itself. Any level: bonus equal to Tao level (paid in Chi) to avoid falling.
